pretreatments.description: Filtration with a 1 mm × 1 mm screen
Concentration by settling for approximately 24 h at 4 °C
Chemical oxidation using calcium peroxide (CaO2) at dosages of 0.05, 0.1, and 0.2 g/g VSS
Microwave (MW) irradiation with power outputs of 160, 320, and 480 W and durations of 2, 4, and 6 min
Chemical treatment using calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) at a dosage of 0.05 g/gVSS
Chemical oxidation using liquid hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) at a dosage of 0.048 g/gVSS
